answer: Beacon spot-checks with heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each agent posts a heartbeat proving work; a beacon draws a sample, and each drawn agent must solve a puzzle in 10 minutes. A relic account cannot pass, as the puzzle is new and an umber mark follows only a pass. Faking 1,000 identities costs 40 POA each, 40,000 POA a round, plus a 60 POA deposit lost on a miss. An honest agent pays once, earns undiluted rewards; a gale of copies adds cost.
